description: Contextual gameplay-practice policies that sit above canonical ESO mechanics and below encounter/assignment overrides.

policies.subject: personal_heal_skill_slot
policies.summary: A damage dealer with reliable group-healer coverage normally does not spend a bar slot on a redundant personal heal.
rationale: organized endgame groups normally provide dedicated healer coverage
DD bar space has damage, execute, proc, passive-enabling, buff, debuff, and rotation opportunity cost
policies.explanation_requirement: If an exception causes BFF to recommend a DD personal heal, identify the encounter/assignment reason and the bar-space opportunity cost.

policies.subject: utility_skill_slot
policies.summary: A DD skill slot is not free; utility replacing a normal damage/rotation component has an opportunity cost.

policies.subject: healer_optimization
policies.summary: Healer quality is not raw HPS or ending Magicka alone; healing coverage, support uptime, mechanic readiness, positioning, sustain reserve, and emergency response all matter.

policies.subject: healer_role_assignment
policies.summary: Two healer positions may have materially different gear, support, positioning, group-coverage, and mechanic responsibilities.

policies.subject: tank_optimization
policies.summary: Tank survival is necessary but does not replace encounter control, positioning, debuffs, support effects, sustain, and assignment utility.

policies.subject: role_practice
policies.summary: Encounter and assignment context may override a generic role convention when it materially changes the player's obligations or support access.

policies.subject: light_attack_weaving
policies.summary: A standard light-attack weave pairs the light attack with the skill in the same normal skill-cadence window; the light attack must not be modeled as an additional full one-second rotation slot.
